data.name: Home_Tip_SpeedAchievement
data.value:
Speed achievement = current speed ÷ target capacity, clamped to 0–100%.
Current speed = (OK+NG) ÷ running hours; RunTime accumulates only while Running and stays unchanged during alarm/standby; speed is 0 if RunTime < 5s.
Now: {0:N0} pcs/h ÷ {1:N0} pcs/h = {2:P0}
Colors: ≥90% green / ≥70% yellow / <70% red. This is not work-order completion.

data.name: Home_Tip_RealtimeSpeed
data.value: Current speed (pcs/h) = (OK + NG) ÷ running hours.\nRunTime accumulates only while Running; during alarm/standby both output and time stay still so speed holds. Below 5s running time the speed is 0 to avoid startup spikes.\nNow: ({0:N0}+{1:N0}) ÷ {2} = {3} pcs/h
